language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi, my name is Carlos and I play soccer in South America.
I’ve got some games to play and need help with some of my math skills! Let’s start by counting by three's and five's.
When you count by three's you are adding three to the previous number to get the next number. 3, 6, 9, 12 etc.
When you count by fives you are adding five to the previous number to get the next number. 5, 10, 15, 20, etc.
And do you already know the commutative property for multiplication. It’s sounds very difficult, but its quite easy.
It means that when we multiply two numbers together we can reverse those numbers and get the same answer.
For example: 2 X 4 = 8 is exactly the same as 4 X 2 = 8. Or take a look at this example: 3 X 9 = 27. This is identical to 9X3 = 27.
What a great performance! Now let’s get started with all the other things we need to do today.
